mapper.sql: id AS calendar_event_id, streamer_id, platform_account_id, event_type, title, memo, start_at, end_at, status
mapper.select: SELECT id AS platform_account_id, streamer_id, CASE WHEN connection_status = 'CONNECTED' AND refresh_token_expires_at IS NOT NULL AND refresh_token_expires_at <= now() THEN 'REAUTH_REQUIRED' ELSE connection_status END AS connection_status FROM platform_accounts WHERE id = #{platformAccountId} AND streamer_id = #{streamerId}

INSERT INTO calendar_events ( streamer_id, platform_account_id, event_type, title, memo, start_at, end_at, status ) VALUES ( #{event.streamerId}, #{event.platformAccountId}, #{event.eventType}, #{event.title}, #{event.memo}, #{event.startAt}, #{event.endAt}, #{event.status} ) RETURNING id
